Question_Text: Does your organization possess an active SOC 2 Type II examination report issued within the past 12 months?
Required_Evidence_Type: CPA SOC 2 Type II PDF Report
Passing_Requirement: Must have unqualified opinion with no major exception

Question_Text: Does your organization maintain an accredited ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certificate covering the in-scope service?
Passing_Requirement: Certificate must be active from IAF-accredited registrar

Question_Text: Is all customer data encrypted at rest using industry-standard AES-256 algorithms?
Passing_Requirement: Mandatory for all production databases and object storage

Question_Text: Is TLS 1.2 or TLS 1.3 strictly enforced for all public internet and API endpoints with deprecated ciphers disabled?
Required_Evidence_Type: Qualys SSL Labs A+ report / Config file
Passing_Requirement: TLS 1.0/1.1 must be disabled; HSTS preloaded

Question_Text: Does your service support SAML 2.0 or OIDC single sign-on (SSO) with Okta?
Passing_Requirement: Mandatory for all Tier 1 and Tier 2 SaaS vendors

Question_Text: Are employee administrator accounts protected by mandatory multi-factor authentication (MFA)?
Required_Evidence_Type: SOC 2 Type II Section III / Policy
Passing_Requirement: SMS OTP prohibited; hardware token or authenticator app required

Question_Text: Do contractual terms guarantee security breach notification to CloudSphere within 72 hours of confirmation?
Required_Evidence_Type: Executed Master Services Agreement or DPA
Passing_Requirement: Must be legally binding in Data Processing Agreement

Question_Text: Does your organization conduct independent third-party penetration testing at least annually?
Passing_Requirement: Must remediate all Critical and High findings prior to contract

Question_Text: Will your organization execute CloudSphere's standard Data Processing Agreement (DPA) including Standard Contractual Clauses?
Passing_Requirement: Mandatory for any vendor processing PII

Question_Text: Are automated daily backups taken and tested regularly for disaster recovery and business continuity?
Passing_Requirement: Documented RTO <= 4 hours and RPO <= 1 hour
